name: 絞り込みと並べ替えとグループ化の検索操作列
prompt: Create ONLY the compact Japanese Lighthouse results-control toolbar, primary original and enlarged original control glyphs authoritative over mock substitutes. Single horizontal row on pure #FFFFFF. FOUR named text controls followed by search icon: exact '絞り込み', '並べ替え', 'グループ', '表示設定'. Restore original missing Options label as 表示設定. Each label preceded by original small slate#526173 glyph, body Meiryo REGULAR14/24 dark#1D1D1D zero tracking, no bold. Glyph1 filter: THREE horizontal strokes centered/decreasing top-to-bottom length, not funnel. Glyph2 sort: TWO vertical arrows, LEFT pointing UP and RIGHT pointing DOWN, shafts with small arrowheads. Glyph3 group: small rounded rectangular outline containing FOUR filled little squares in a2x2grid separated by white cross gap, not document lines. Restore thin neutral VERTICAL DIVIDER between Group and Options. Glyph4 options: TWO horizontal strokes, UPPER HOLLOW circular knob at RIGHT and LOWER HOLLOW knob at LEFT (opposite of other controls; match this original exactly). Then original outline magnifying circle with short diagonal down-right handle, no text. Keep glyphs small, height approximately equal to body character height, source quiet stroke/optical proportions. Original controls are unobtrusive text buttons with no individual card borders, preserve this; mock outlined text-only boxes/document substitute incorrect. Compact balanced gaps, align baseline, keep complete five controls in one native-width approx390px toolbar by modest spacing, not large poster. No selection, green accent, heading, shadow, phone chrome, extra row, button fill or unrelated table headers. Entire Japanese text and utility glyphs readable. Static raster, no actual filtering/sorting/search behavior claim.
reviewNotes: All4named controls plus search restored, correct source anatomy including group4filledsquares, upperright/lowerleft hollow settings knobs and vertical separator. Japanese Regular copy complete. Utility glyphs too large/heavy relative to source text; targeted scale correction allnamedglyphs75percent/search70percent needed.
